key_idea: Line the shapes up from heaviest to lightest, one scale at a time.
steps: Square and circle: the square side is lower, so the square is heavier than the circle.
Triangle and square: the triangle is heavier.
Star and triangle: the star is heavier. Star and diamond: the star is heavier.
The star is heavier than every other shape.

choice_feedback.A: The square is heavier than the circle.
choice_feedback.B: The triangle is heavier than the square.
choice_feedback.D: The star is heavier than the triangle.
choice_feedback.E: The star is heavier than the diamond.
